constraints.name: ck_appointment_assignment_actor
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((actor_type)::text = 'SYSTEM'::text) AND (actor_id IS NULL)) OR (((actor_type)::text = 'HUMAN'::text) AND (actor_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_email_task_lease
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'SENDING'::text) AND (lease_token IS NOT NULL)) OR (((status)::text <> 'SENDING'::text) AND (lease_token IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_email_task_status
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'SENDING'::character varying, 'SENT'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SUPERSEDED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_email_task_type
constraints.definition: CHECK (((task_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ADMIN_REASSIGNMENT'::character varying, 'OWNER_REASSIGNED'::character varying, 'OWNER_CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'OWNER_REJECTED'::character varying, 'OWNER_CANCELLED'::character varying, 'OWNER_RESCHEDULED'::character varying, 'OWNER_REMINDER'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_administrative_event
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((event_type)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['CANCELLED'::character varying, 'NO_SHOW'::character varying, 'RESCHEDULED'::character varying])::text[])) OR (((actor_type)::text = 'HUMAN'::text) AND (reason IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim((reason)::text) <> ''::text) AND (previous_status IS NOT NULL) AND (new_status IS NOT NULL) AND ((((event_type)::text = 'CANCELLED'::text) AND ((previous_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REQUESTED'::character varying, 'CONFIRMED'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((new_status)::text = 'CANCELLED'::text)) OR (((event_type)::text = 'NO_SHOW'::text) AND ((previous_status)::text = 'CONFIRMED'::text) AND ((new_status)::text = 'NO_SHOW'::text)) OR (((event_type)::text = 'RESCHEDULED'::text) AND ((previous_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REQUESTED'::character varying, 'CONFIRMED'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((new_status)::text = (previous_status)::text) AND (previous_slot_id IS NOT NULL) AND (new_slot_id IS NOT NULL) AND (previous_slot_id <> new_slot_id))))))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_clinical_completion
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((event_type)::text <> 'COMPLETED'::text) OR (((actor_type)::text = 'HUMAN'::text) AND (actor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (previous_status IS NOT NULL) AND ((previous_status)::text = 'CONFIRMED'::text) AND (new_status IS NOT NULL) AND ((new_status)::text = 'COMPLETED'::text) AND (previous_assignment_status IS NOT NULL) AND ((previous_assignment_status)::text = 'ASSIGNED'::text) AND (new_assignment_status IS NOT NULL) AND ((new_assignment_status)::text = 'ASSIGNED'::text))))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_event_actor
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((actor_type)::text = 'SYSTEM'::text) AND (actor_id IS NULL)) OR (((actor_type)::text = 'HUMAN'::text) AND (actor_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_event_agreement
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((event_type)::text <> 'RESCHEDULED'::text) AND (agreement_channel IS NULL) AND (agreement_contacted_at IS NULL) AND (agreement_note IS NULL)) OR ((agreement_channel IS NOT NULL) AND ((agreement_channel)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PHONE'::character varying, 'WHATSAPP'::character varying, 'OTHER'::character varying])::text[])) AND (agreement_contacted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (agreement_note IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim((agreement_note)::text) <> ''::text))))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_event_status
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((previous_status IS NULL) OR ((previous_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REQUESTED'::character varying, 'CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying, 'NO_SHOW'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying])::text[]))) AND ((new_status IS NULL) OR ((new_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REQUESTED'::character varying, 'CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying, 'NO_SHOW'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying])::text[])))))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_event_type
constraints.definition: CHECK (((event_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REQUESTED'::character varying, 'CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying, 'NO_SHOW'::character varying, 'RESCHEDULED'::character varying, 'DAILY_CUTOFF'::character varying, 'VETERINARIAN_DISABLED'::character varying, 'VETERINARIAN_RESTORED'::character varying, 'REASSIGNED'::character varying, 'EMAIL_ACCESSED'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_appointment_status
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REQUESTED'::character varying, 'CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying, 'NO_SHOW'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_clinical_encounter_event_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((event_type)::text = 'CREATED'::text) AND (encounter_version = 0) AND (previous_veterinarian_id IS NULL)) OR (((event_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['UPDATED'::character varying, 'TREATMENT_UPDATED'::character varying, 'FINALIZED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (encounter_version > 0) AND (previous_veterinarian_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_clinical_encounter_event_type
constraints.definition: CHECK (((event_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CREATED'::character varying, 'UPDATED'::character varying, 'TREATMENT_UPDATED'::character varying, 'FINALIZED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_clinical_encounter_operation_type
constraints.definition: CHECK (((operation_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CREATE'::character varying, 'UPDATE'::character varying, 'TREATMENT'::character varying, 'FINALIZE'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_clinical_encounter_finalization
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'DRAFT'::text) AND (finalized_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'FINALIZED'::text) AND (finalized_at IS NOT NULL) AND (finalized_at >= created_at) AND (reason IS NOT NULL) AND (anamnesis IS NOT NULL) AND (physical_examination IS NOT NULL) AND (diagnosis IS NOT NULL) AND (care_plan IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_clinical_reminder_task_lease
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'SENDING'::text) AND (lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_until IS NOT NULL)) OR (((status)::text <> 'SENDING'::text) AND (lease_token IS NULL) AND (lease_until IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_clinical_reminder_task_state
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'SENDING'::character varying, 'SENT'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SUPERSEDED'::character varying, 'EXPIRED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_clinical_reminder_source
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((source_type)::text = 'PRESCRIPTION'::text) AND (prescription_id IS NOT NULL) AND (control_id IS NULL) AND (interval_hours IS NOT NULL) AND ((interval_hours >= 1) AND (interval_hours <= 168))) OR (((source_type)::text = 'CONTROL'::text) AND (control_id IS NOT NULL) AND (prescription_id IS NULL) AND (interval_hours IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_clinical_reminder_state
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (next_due_at IS NOT NULL) AND (next_due_at >= starts_at) AND (next_due_at < ends_at)) OR (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['FINISHED'::character varying, 'SUPERSEDED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (next_due_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: clinical_reminder_schedules_encounter_id_control_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (encounter_id, control_id) REFERENCES clinical_controls(encounter_id, id)

constraints.name: clinical_reminder_schedules_encounter_id_prescription_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (encounter_id, prescription_id) REFERENCES clinical_prescriptions(encounter_id, id)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: ck_password_recovery_email_expiry
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((task_type)::text = 'RECOVERY_CODE'::text) AND (expires_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (((task_type)::text = 'RESET_NOTIFICATION'::text) AND (expires_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_password_recovery_email_lease
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'SENDING'::text) AND (lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (((status)::text <> 'SENDING'::text) AND (lease_token IS NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_password_recovery_email_payload
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'SENDING'::character varying])::text[])) AND (encrypted_payload IS NOT NULL) AND (octet_length(encrypted_payload) >= 16) AND (payload_nonce IS NOT NULL) AND (octet_length(payload_nonce) = 12)) OR (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SENT'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SUPERSEDED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (encrypted_payload IS NULL) AND (payload_nonce IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_password_recovery_email_status
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'SENDING'::character varying, 'SENT'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'SUPERSEDED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: password_recovery_email_tasks_user_id_fkey

constraints.definition: CHECK (((sex IS NULL) OR ((sex)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['MALE'::character varying, 'FEMALE'::character varying, 'UNKNOWN'::character varying])::text[]))))

constraints.name: ck_staff_invitation_email_failure
constraints.definition: CHECK (((last_failure_code IS NULL) OR ((last_failure_code)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SMTP_DELIVERY_FAILED'::character varying, 'INVITATION_DELIVERY_FAILED'::character varying])::text[]))))

constraints.name: ck_staff_invitation_email_status
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'SENT'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying, 'EXPIRED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: staff_invitation_email_tasks_invitation_id_fkey

constraints.name: staff_invitations_user_id_fkey

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status)::text <> 'PENDING_ACTIVATION'::text) OR (((role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ADMINISTRATOR'::character varying, 'VETERINARIAN'::character varying])::text[])) AND (password_hash IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_users_role
constraints.definition: CHECK (((role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['OWNER'::character varying, 'VETERINARIAN'::character varying, 'ADMINISTRATOR'::character varying, 'SUPER_ADMIN'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_veterinarian_availability_event_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((event_type)::text = 'CREATED'::text) AND (previous_starts_at IS NULL) AND (previous_ends_at IS NULL) AND (previous_status IS NULL) AND (reason IS NULL) AND (slot_version = 0)) OR (((event_type)::text <> 'CREATED'::text) AND (previous_starts_at IS NOT NULL) AND (previous_ends_at IS NOT NULL) AND (previous_status IS NOT NULL) AND (reason IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim((reason)::text) <> ''::text) AND (slot_version > 0))))

constraints.name: ck_veterinarian_availability_event_status
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((previous_status IS NULL) OR ((previous_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PUBLISHED'::character varying, 'BLOCKED'::character varying])::text[]))) AND ((new_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PUBLISHED'::character varying, 'BLOCKED'::character varying])::text[]))))

constraints.name: ck_veterinarian_availability_event_type
constraints.definition: CHECK (((event_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CREATED'::character varying, 'RESCHEDULED'::character varying, 'BLOCKED'::character varying, 'PUBLISHED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_veterinarian_availability_grid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((date_trunc('minute'::text, starts_at) = starts_at) AND (mod(EXTRACT(epoch FROM starts_at), (1800)::numeric) = (0)::numeric)))
